scripts.api: cd backend && uv run fastapi dev app/main.py
scripts.db:up: brew services start postgresql@17 && brew services start redis
scripts.db:down: brew services stop postgresql@17 && brew services stop redis
scripts.db:seed: cd backend && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.check: cd backend && uv run pytest && uv run ruff check . && uv run mypy . && cd ../apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit
